python3 -I -B - <<'__SOURCE__'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,stat
assert len(os.environ['ASSET_EXPECTED_B64'])<=90000
raw=base64.b64decode(os.environ['ASSET_EXPECTED_B64'],validate=True)
assert len(raw)<=65536
def pairs(items):
 result={}
 for key,value in items:
  assert key not in result,'duplicate expected key'
  result[key]=value
 return result
expected=json.loads(raw,object_pairs_hook=pairs)
assert set(expected)=={'schema','sourceCommit','sourceFiles','ownerFiles','dockerfile','buildspec','builderAuthority','cleanup'}
assert expected['schema']=='meri-host-assets-build-input/3'
assert expected['sourceCommit']==os.environ['SOURCE_COMMIT']
paths=['bootstrap.sh','host-evidence.py','host_evidence/__init__.py','host_evidence/admission.py','host_evidence/browser_capture.py','host_evidence/classification.py','host_evidence/cli.py','host_evidence/collection.py','host_evidence/config.py','host_evidence/evidence_io.py','host_evidence/export_protocol.py','host_evidence/poll.py','host_evidence/source_binding.py','seccomp.json']
assert len(expected['sourceFiles'])==14
assert [f['assetPath'] for f in expected['sourceFiles']]==paths
source_paths=['infra/browser-qualification/'+('seccomp.chromium-155-amd64.json' if p=='seccomp.json' else p) for p in paths]
assert [f['path'] for f in expected['sourceFiles']]==source_paths
owners=['infra/browser-qualification/app.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/asset-loader.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/asset-sources.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/asset-verifier.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/cli.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/config.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/legacy-classifier.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/stack.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/js/user-data.mjs','infra/browser-qualification/component-pins.json']
assert [f['path'] for f in expected['ownerFiles']]==owners
for name,path in [('dockerfile','infra/qualification/host-assets.Dockerfile'),('buildspec','infra/qualification/host-assets.buildspec.json'),('builderAuthority','infra/qualification/app.mjs'),('cleanup','scripts/clear-qualification-docker-config.py')]:assert expected[name]['path']==path
files=expected['sourceFiles']+expected['ownerFiles']+[expected[k] for k in ('dockerfile','buildspec','builderAuthority','cleanup')]
for f in files:
 assert set(f)==({'path','assetPath','bytes','sha256'} if f in expected['sourceFiles'] else {'path','bytes','sha256'})
 assert type(f['bytes']) is int and 0<f['bytes']<=2097152 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',f['sha256'])
 p=pathlib.Path(f['path'])
 for parent in p.parents:
  st=parent.lstat();assert stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)
 st=p.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1 and st.st_size==f['bytes']
 fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|getattr(os,'O_NOFOLLOW',0)|getattr(os,'O_BINARY',0))
 try:
  def identity(s):return(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,getattr(s,'st_birthtime_ns',s.st_ctime_ns) if os.name=='nt' else s.st_ctime_ns)
  opened=os.fstat(fd);assert identity(st)==identity(opened)
  with os.fdopen(fd,'rb',closefd=False) as stream:data=stream.read(f['bytes']+1)
  assert identity(opened)==identity(os.fstat(fd))==identity(p.lstat())
 finally:os.close(fd)
 assert len(data)==f['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
with pathlib.Path('host-assets-expected.json').open('x') as out:out.write(json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
__SOURCE__
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws sts get-caller-identity --region us-east-1 --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-build-identity.json
python3 -I -B - <<'__IDENTITY__'
import json
identity=json.load(open('host-assets-build-identity.json'))
assert identity['Account']=='967807252336'
assert identity['Arn'].startswith('arn:aws:sts::967807252336:assumed-role/MeriGreenfield-QualificationBui-BuilderRoleBBEBFA71-8G97EeNmFM0H/')
__IDENTITY__
AUTH_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/meri-worker-auth.XXXXXXXX)
export AUTH_DIR
AUTH_IDENTITY=$(python3 -I -B -c 'import os,stat; p=os.environ["AUTH_DIR"]; s=os.lstat(p); assert stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o700 and s.st_uid==0; print(str(s.st_dev)+":"+str(s.st_ino))')
export AUTH_IDENTITY
asset_id=''
cleanup() {
 local rc=$? failed=0
 trap - EXIT INT TERM
 set +e
 if [ -z "$asset_id" ] && [ -f host-assets-container-id.txt ]; then asset_id=$(cat host-assets-container-id.txt); fi
 if [[ "$asset_id" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]; then
  timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" rm "$asset_id" >/dev/null || failed=1
  left=$(timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" container ls --all --no-trunc --filter "id=$asset_id" --format '{{.ID}}') || failed=1
  [ -z "$left" ] || failed=1
 fi
 timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" logout 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com >/dev/null 2>&1 || failed=1
 timeout --signal=KILL 30 python3 -I -B scripts/clear-qualification-docker-config.py --nonce "${AUTH_DIR##*.}" --identity "$AUTH_IDENTITY" > host-assets-auth-cleanup-trap.json || failed=1
 [ ! -e "$AUTH_DIR" ] && [ ! -L "$AUTH_DIR" ] || failed=1
 [ "$failed" = 0 ] || { echo 'Owned build cleanup unconfirmed; image unadmitted' >&2; rc=1; }
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | timeout --signal=KILL 90 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
timeout --signal=KILL 120 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" build --network none --pull=false --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg "SOURCE_COMMIT=$SOURCE_COMMIT" --iidfile host-assets-image-id.txt -f infra/qualification/host-assets.Dockerfile -t "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" .
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" image inspect "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" > host-assets-image-inspect.json
python3 -I -B - <<'__IMAGE__'
import json,os,re
rows=json.load(open('host-assets-image-inspect.json'));assert len(rows)==1
i=rows[0]
assert re.fullmatch('sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}',i['Id']) and i['Os']=='linux' and i['Architecture']=='amd64'
assert i['Id']==open('host-assets-image-id.txt').read().strip()
c=i['Config'];assert not c.get('Entrypoint') and not c.get('Cmd') and not c.get('Volumes')
assert c.get('Env') in (None,[],['PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin'])
assert c['Labels']['org.opencontainers.image.revision']==os.environ['SOURCE_COMMIT']
assert c['Labels']['meri.qualification.kind']=='browser-host-support-only'
assert c['Labels']['meri.browser.asset-protocol']=='2'
__IMAGE__
asset_id=$(timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" create --cidfile host-assets-container-id.txt --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" /meri-never-start-host-assets)
[[ "$asset_id" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
[ "$(cat host-assets-container-id.txt)" = "$asset_id" ]
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" container inspect "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-before.json
mkdir host-assets-extracted
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" cp "$asset_id:/meri-host-assets/." host-assets-extracted/
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" container inspect "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-after.json
python3 -I -B - <<'__EXTRACTED__'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,stat
expected=json.load(open('host-assets-expected.json'));cid=pathlib.Path('host-assets-container-id.txt').read_text().strip()
for name in ('before','after'):
 rows=json.load(open('host-assets-container-'+name+'.json'));assert len(rows)==1
 i=rows[0];assert i['Id']==cid and i['Image']==json.load(open('host-assets-image-inspect.json'))[0]['Id']
 assert i['Config']['Image']==os.environ['REPOSITORY_URI']+':'+os.environ['IMAGE_TAG']
 s=i['State'];assert s['Status']=='created' and s['Running'] is False and s['Pid']==0 and i['RestartCount']==0
 for key in ('Paused','Restarting','Dead','OOMKilled'):assert s[key] is False
 assert s['ExitCode']==0 and s['Error']=='' and s['StartedAt']=='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z' and s['FinishedAt']=='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'
root=pathlib.Path('host-assets-extracted');package=root/'host_evidence'
assert stat.S_ISDIR(root.lstat().st_mode) and stat.S_ISDIR(package.lstat().st_mode)
assert {p.name for p in root.iterdir()}=={'bootstrap.sh','host-evidence.py','seccomp.json','host_evidence'}
assert {p.name for p in package.iterdir()}=={f['assetPath'].split('/')[1] for f in expected['sourceFiles'] if '/' in f['assetPath']}
for f in expected['sourceFiles']:
 p=root/f['assetPath'];st=p.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1 and st.st_size==f['bytes']
 with p.open('rb') as stream:data=stream.read(f['bytes']+1)
 assert len(data)==f['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
 assert data==pathlib.Path(f['path']).read_bytes()
__EXTRACTED__
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" rm "$asset_id" > host-assets-container-removed.txt
[ "$(cat host-assets-container-removed.txt)" = "$asset_id" ]
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" container ls --all --no-trunc --filter "id=$asset_id" --format '{{.ID}}' > host-assets-container-removal-readback.txt
[ ! -s host-assets-container-removal-readback.txt ]
asset_id=''
rm host-assets-container-id.txt
# A pushed image can remain after a later failure; it stays UNADMITTED.
timeout --signal=KILL 300 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" push "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG"
timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws ecr describe-images --region us-east-1 --repository-name meri-greenfield/qualification-worker --image-ids "imageTag=$IMAGE_TAG" --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-ecr-image.json
# Owned credential purge must finish before publishing a result.
timeout --signal=KILL 30 docker --config "$AUTH_DIR" logout 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com >/dev/null 2>&1
(set -C; timeout --signal=KILL 30 python3 -I -B scripts/clear-qualification-docker-config.py --nonce "${AUTH_DIR##*.}" --identity "$AUTH_IDENTITY" > host-assets-auth-cleanup.json)
python3 -I -B - <<'__CLEANED__'
import json,os,re
ac=json.load(open('host-assets-auth-cleanup.json'));root=os.environ['AUTH_DIR']
assert re.fullmatch(r'/tmp/meri-worker-auth\.[A-Za-z0-9]{8}',root)
assert ac['schema']=='meri-worker-auth-cleanup/1' and ac['status']=='CLEANED' and ac['verifiedAbsent'] is True and ac['rootObserved'] is True
assert root==ac['parent']+'/'+ac['directoryName'] and ac['policy']=='fd-relative-nofollow-root-owned-bounded/1'
assert ac['boundIdentity']==list(map(int,os.environ['AUTH_IDENTITY'].split(':')))
try:os.lstat(root)
except FileNotFoundError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('auth root remains')

[ ! -e "$AUTH_DIR" ] && [ ! -L "$AUTH_DIR" ]

python3 -I -B - <<'__RESULT__'

expected=json.load(open('host-assets-expected.json'));rows=json.load(open('host-assets-ecr-image.json'))['imageDetails'];assert len(rows)==1
e=rows[0];assert e['registryId']=='967807252336' and e['repositoryName']=='meri-greenfield/qualification-worker'
assert os.environ['IMAGE_TAG'] in e['imageTags'] and re.fullmatch('sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}',e['imageDigest'])
source={'schema':'meri-browser-source/2','assets':[{'path':f['assetPath'],'bytes':f['bytes'],'sha256':f['sha256']} for f in expected['sourceFiles']]}
raw=(json.dumps(source,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('ascii')
m={'schema':'meri-host-assets-build-result/3','status':'PACKAGED_NOT_RUNTIME_QUALIFIED','sourceCommit':os.environ['SOURCE_COMMIT'],'sourceArchiveSha256':os.environ['SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256'],'sourceS3Version':os.environ['SOURCE_S3_VERSION'],'imageTag':os.environ['IMAGE_TAG'],'imageDigest':e['imageDigest'],'imageUri':os.environ['REPOSITORY_URI']+'@'+e['imageDigest'],'buildId':os.environ['CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID'],'createdAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'expected':expected,'ecrImage':e,'imageInspect':json.load(open('host-assets-image-inspect.json'))[0],'assetContainerBefore':json.load(open('host-assets-container-before.json'))[0],'assetContainerAfter':json.load(open('host-assets-container-after.json'))[0],'assetContainerRemoved':pathlib.Path('host-assets-container-removed.txt').read_text().strip(),'source':source,'sourceManifest':{'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},'fourteenFixedFilesByteCompared':True,'sourceManifestCoverage':True,'assetContainerNeverStarted':True,'authCleanup':json.load(open('host-assets-auth-cleanup.json')),'ownedCredentialsPurged':True,'workerImageBuilt':False,'assetRuntimeExecuted':False,'independentDigestVerification':'NOT_RUN'}
pathlib.Path('host-assets-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')

timeout --signal=KILL 90 aws s3api put-object --region us-east-1 --bucket meri-greenfield-qual-build-967807252336-us-east-1 --key "results/host-assets-$SOURCE_COMMIT/manifest.json" --body host-assets-manifest.json --if-none-match '*' --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:967807252336:key/1cca74fc-d9ae-43a6-8bfd-b93107e90042 --checksum-algorithm SHA256 --checksum-sha256 "$result_checksum" --metadata "sourcecommit=$SOURCE_COMMIT" --output json --no-cli-pager > host-assets-result-upload.json
